It is about 85 percent returned from the strike. Retain continuous limb geometry, no new claw, no chest reveal. Shell and eye settle gently, feet support in place.
Reference4 is previous frame, preserve exact geometry, size, fixed rear camera and limb root connections. Change only the specified crab joints and small settling details. No global translation, scale change, limb-count changes or duplicate claw outlines.
